events.verdict: Nurkic (POR) is the last to touch the ball prior to making contact with the ball in the backcourt.
Horford (BOS) is in the path of Lillard (POR) and does not deliver contact.
Nurkic (POR) maintains a legal guarding position on Irving's (BOS) jump shot.
Nurkic (POR) dislodges Horford (BOS) during the rebound.
Nurkic (POR) is in the path of Smart (BOS) and does not deliver contact during the screen.
[Observable in Enhanced Video] Horford (BOS) slides his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Lillard (POR) engages with Irving (BOS) but does not affect his FOM.
Nurkic (POR) makes incidental high-five contact with Irving's (BOS) hand after he has released the ball.
Nurkic (POR) makes contact with the ball as Tatum (BOS) attempts to gather the rebound.
LAR shows Turner (POR) takes away Tatum's (BOS) landing area on his jump shot attempt.
Irving (BOS) makes contact with Lillard's (POR) hand that is on the ball during his driving shot attempt. The contact is deemed incidental.
Horford (BOS) is in the paint and actively guarding an opponent within three seconds.
Horford (BOS) holds Nurkic's (POR) arm and affects his ability to retrieve the rebound.
Irving (BOS) cleanly steals the ball from Turner (POR).
Irving (BOS) takes two legal steps after the gather.
Turner (POR) maintains a legal guarding position on Irving's (BOS) shot.
